extracted.name: Baked feta with peas, chilli & preserved lemon
extracted.description: Make the most of fresh podded peas in the summer with this fiery, zingy baked feta recipe. It's a sensational lunch for two with crusty bread
ingredient_lines: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil plus a drizzle to serve
1 preserved lemon deseeded and finely chopped
small handful of mint leaves finely chopped, plus extra leaves to serve
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/ gas 8. Put the feta in a small baking dish and drizzle with 1 tbsp of the oil, then scatter over half the chilli and half the preserved lemon. Bake for 20 mins.
Blanch the peas for 2 mins, then drain and, while still warm, toss with the remaining oil, chilli and preserved lemon, the mint and the lemon juice. Season.
Spoon the peas into the baking dish around the feta, and top with extra mint leaves, the lemon zest and a drizzle of oil. Serve with crusty bread.
